description:
In Interactive.do_run, call Loader.discover_and_load/2 with standard_dirs(cwd). For each loaded extension, call Loader.init_extension/2 with an API bound via Interactive.build_ui_context(self()). Store extensions: [Extension.t()] in Interactive state. Fire :session_start event via Dispatcher.emit after session is started.

Upstream ref: interactive-mode.ts loadExtensions(), initializeExtension().
Affected file: apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/interactive.ex
title: Load extensions at startup — discover, init, bind UIContext
